caption: The drawing depicts a single human figure standing on a rectangular patch of green resembling grass. The figure is oriented facing slightly to the left and wears a long-sleeved, light-colored, plaid-patterned shirt and a knee-length yellowish skirt decorated with red X-shaped patterns. The person also wears tan or brown leggings and matching moccasin-like footwear. The head features black hair and is adorned with red and brown feathers. Around the neck, there are visible necklaces or beaded adornments. The figure holds a long brown staff in the right hand and an object resembling a tomahawk, axe, or cane in the left hand. The scene occupies the central portion of a larger, off-white or beige background with squared edges, and the rendering uses a flat, textile or applique style with minimal shading.
